historical_record.description: The Geary-Presidio car barn and bus yard filled all of Block 1072 (235,950 square feet). On the Geary Boulevard frontage stood an old car barn used for Municipal Railway offices, a bus maintenance shop and storage of voting machines; the northerly part was an open storage yard for trolley coaches and motor buses.
